A three-panel horizontal illustration comparing power sources in the field. Left panel: A tired-looking farmer swinging a short-handled hoe in a small unweeded plot (Human power). Middle panel: Two large White Fulani bulls with a wooden yoke pulling a metal plough, guided by a farmer with a stick (Animal power). Right panel: A modern red tractor pulling a disc plough across a large, neat field, with a little exhaust smoke coming from the pipe (Mechanical power).

An illustration showing the physical challenges of mechanization in a tropical rainforest zone. A modern tractor is shown struggling in a muddy field. The tractor's disc plough is caught and bent on a massive, deep-rooted tree stump hidden in the soil. The driver looks frustrated, holding a wrench.
